name: Gog
bio: Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal in the land of Magog, was the subject of Ezekiel's prophecy against him: God declared he would turn Gog around and bring him against Israel in a future invasion with a vast army, only to destroy him on the mountains of Israel, giving the birds and beasts his fallen armies to devour and burying Gog's own dead in a valley, so that all nations would know God's holiness (Ezekiel 38-39). The name is later invoked in Revelation to describe the nations that gather for a final rebellion against God before the end, led astray by Satan (Revelation 20:8).
